title: CYBRIK Tool Execution Receipt Ledger Schema v1
description: JSON Schema Draft 2020-12 defining the tamper-evident, append-only Execution Receipt Ledger for Tool Fabric actions (Pillars 5, 9, & 10). Cryptographically binds sequence numbers, caller identities, delegation chains, execution receipt digests, Merkle root hashes, and control-plane signatures. Status: ACCEPTED FOR IMPLEMENTATION (v1.0.0; Pillars 5 & 10 contract).

ledger_id.description: Unique UUID identifying this ledger block / segment.

tenant_id.description: Authoritative tenant identifier governing this execution ledger.

sequence_number.description: Monotonically increasing sequence index within the tenant's ledger chain.

epoch.description: Ledger rotation epoch or sealing period identifier.

status.description: Lifecycle state of the ledger block (active = receiving receipts; sealed = immutable hash closed).

caller_identity.description: Authenticated service or agent identity operating the ledger segment.

receipts.description: Ordered array of tool execution receipts included in this ledger block.

receipt_id.description: Unique identifier of the execution receipt.

action_id.description: Correlation action ID assigned by the orchestrator or fabric.

risk_class.description: Assigned risk tier (R0 read-metadata to R3 side-effect).

delegation_ref.description: Digest of the delegation chain granting authority for this execution.

receipt_digest.description: Cryptographic digest of the individual execution receipt.

signature_ref.description: Reference key to control-plane signature over the individual receipt.

hashes.description: Cryptographic hash chain linkage and Merkle tree root for tamper evidence.

previous_ledger_digest.description: SHA-256 digest of sequence_number - 1 ledger block (or sha256:000... for genesis block).

merkle_root.description: Binary Merkle tree root calculated over all receipt_digest items in order.

receipts_aggregate_hash.description: Cumulative rolling SHA-256 digest over receipts array.

signatures.description: Control-plane and auditor cryptographic signatures sealing this ledger block.

started_at.description: Timestamp of the earliest receipt recorded in this block.

closed_at.description: Timestamp when the ledger block was sealed and signed.

receipt_count.description: Total number of execution receipts contained in this block.

digest.description: SHA-256 digest of the complete canonical ledger block (excluding digest itself).

metadata.description: Optional administrative audit tags and retention metadata.
